title: App wont work
body: I payed for the app via instagram and once I downloaded it was stuck on the login page, meaning I didn’t even try it. I have sent an email and waited 3 weeks with no reply and no refund.
author: Charbel@yaz

title: Hidden Charge Without Permission
body:
This app charged me $9 as expected, but later they took $55 without my permission. The subscription still shows as “for free”, and the $55 charge is hidden and not visible in my purchases.

This is completely unacceptable and misleading. Users should be aware that unauthorized charges can happen. I strongly urge the developers to refund the $55 immediately and fix this issue.
author: Yousseffffg

title: Refunding money
body: I have deleted the app from my AppStore, i received a message today for deduction of 80$ for your application while I didn’t ask for renewal and I didn’t like the app when I check manage subscription thru the app (i re-installed it) to get my money back and to find the refund policy the subscription tab take me to my subscriptions page on Appstore and I don’t find your application, please refund my money back I didn’t ask for renewal
